25: legend Weight and Resistance versus contents/body Weight.
34: legend Comparison versus chapter Comparison,and General Harmony.
337 rejects an extra Conditionality organ; it is not another numbered entry.
Title Second American from Third London; preface mentions fourth edition. No edition equivalence assumed.

conventions.selection: Exact label ID or case-insensitive exact documented name/alias; no fuzzy inference
conventions.orientation: Printed panels only; no anatomical laterality assigned
conventions.locations: Qualitative transcription,not calibrated boundaries. Missing panel anchors remain unknown.
conventions.descriptions: 15 selected passage paraphrases;22 legend/category-only entries,not full chapter coverage
conventions.traditions: Spurzheim1833 only; Gall and Combe unsupported

scientific_scope: Phrenology is scientifically discredited. Historical map fidelity does not validate skull-to-trait inference. No personal measurements,images or individual assessments.
research_cutoff: Coherent original legend,three views,selected descriptions and independent manual fixtures verified; no further edition research required for core
